text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Mihono Bourbon about our plans regarding training and promo concerts leading up to the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: I'm asking what you think, not ordering you.
I'm asking what you think, not ordering you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello described the Grand Concert as a stage for runners to convey their gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why, if Bourbon's going to perform, I want her to do it because she wants to, not because I "order" her to.
choice_data_list: If you want, you can observe first before deciding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If there ever comes a day when she wants to perform of her own volition, then we'll talk about getting her up on stage.
